# Weeknight Beef Rice Bowls

## Ingredients

- 1.5 lb ground beef
- 1 cup dry white rice
- 1 medium onion
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 stick unsalted butter
- 2 lemons
- freshly ground black pepper
- handful fresh spinach

## Instructions

1. Brown the ground beef in the olive oil over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.
2. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and cook until softened.
3. Stir in the dry rice and water, cover, and simmer until the rice is tender.
4. Finish the sauce with butter, lemon zest, and lemon juice.
5. Season with freshly ground black pepper and fold in the spinach at the end.
6. Spoon into bowls and serve.

## Notes

A deliberately boring weeknight dinner used as the Phase 8B production-browser
acceptance fixture. Every ingredient is an unbranded, non-adversarial pantry
line with no range, no `or`, no `to taste`, and no package-size ambiguity.
